hook.en: Steady pressure held on a tender knot in a muscle until its pain eases, usually followed by stretching.
hook.ur: Trigger-Point Pressure Release mein muscle ke ek sensitive hissay par ahista, bardasht ke qabil pressure diya jata hai aur symptoms ka response dekha jata hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what Trigger-Point Pressure Release is, when it's safe and useful, how to apply it step by step — and how to prove it worked. (3 checks along the way.)
goal.ur: End tak aap jaan jayenge ke Trigger-Point Pressure Release kya hai, kab safe aur faida-mand hai, qadam ba qadam kaise apply hoti hai — aur kaise prove karein ke kaam kiya. (Raste mein 3 checks.)

text.en: A trigger point is a sore, tight spot in a muscle band that, when pressed, can reproduce the patient's pain or refer pain elsewhere. Trigger-point pressure release (ischemic compression) means holding steady, tolerable pressure on it until the tenderness drops.
text.ur: Muscle ke clinically relevant hypersensitive area par sustained pressure diya jata hai, aur symptom reproduction ya relief ko monitor kiya jata hai.

text.en: Like pressing a sore spot on a stiff rubber band until it softens. Gentle persistence works better than a quick jab.
text.ur: Jaise akri hui rubber band ke dard wale hisse ko dheere dheere dabana jab tak woh naram na ho jaye. Halki magar musalsal koshish ek tez chubhan se behtar kaam karti hai.

text.en:
Three ideas carry this whole technique:
**1.** The goal is to reproduce the familiar pain, which suggests the right spot, not to create new pain.
**2.** Pressure should be strong but tolerable, around 5-6 out of 10.
**3.** Follow with gentle stretching and movement so the benefit lasts.
text.ur: Pressure se pain sensitivity aur muscle tone mein aarzi tabdeeli aa sakti hai. Trigger points ko proven fixed structural knot ke bajaye clinical pain phenomenon samajhna zyada munasib hai. Long-term improvement ke liye load, movement, sleep, stress aur exercise jaise factors ko address karna aam tor par zaroori hota hai.

question.ur: Pehle vocabulary — clinicians yeh lafz bohat use karte hain. **Trigger point** ka matlab kya hai?

text.en:
So when does **Trigger-Point Pressure Release** make sense?
• Muscle pain with a clear tender spot that reproduces the patient's pain.
• Headaches from neck and shoulder muscles.
• Pain with restricted muscle movement.
text.ur: Localized myofascial pain; muscle se related referred pain patterns.

text.en:
And just as important — when you should NOT use it, or should stop:
• Infection, open wounds, or fragile skin.
• People on strong blood thinners or with bleeding disorders, unless discussed with their doctor.
• Pressure that causes sharp pain or numbness.
text.ur:
Anticoagulation, allodynia, ya sensation mein kami.
Khula zakhm, acute muscle tear, hematoma, DVT ya infection.
Trigger point ko har pain ka sabab samajhna aur bruising ya marked flare ko normal treatment response kehna ghalat hai. Relevant medical history, tissue sensitivity aur contraindications ko pehle consider karein.

title.en: How to do it — 6 steps, each with its reason
title.ur: Kaise karein — 6 qadam, har ek ki wajah ke saath

steps.title: Find the taut band
steps.detail: Slide across the muscle fibres to feel a rope-like band and a tender spot.

steps.title: Confirm the spot
steps.detail: Gentle pressure should reproduce the familiar pain.

steps.title: Apply steady pressure
steps.detail: Press to the point where the patient feels strong but tolerable discomfort.

steps.title: Hold and wait
steps.detail: Hold 30-90 seconds until the tenderness reduces.

steps.title: Stretch and retest
steps.detail: Gently stretch the muscle and retest pain or range.

beats.ur:
1. Aisa sensitive area identify karein jo patient ke relevant symptoms ko reproduce karta ho.
2. Achanak ya bohat zyada force ke bajaye pressure dheere barhayein.
3. Symptoms settle hon to pressure maintain ya modify karein.
4. Pressure ahista release karke movement dobara assess karein.
5. Impairment ke mutabiq mobility ya strengthening add karein.

question.en: Imagine the patient is in front of you. What do you do FIRST?
question.ur: Farz karein patient aap ke saamne hai. Aap SAB SE PEHLE kya karenge?

text.en: How much? Typical teaching range: 30-90 seconds, repeated 2-3 times per spot, followed by stretching. If tenderness does not reduce after several holds, change the plan.
text.ur: Aksar har site par 20–90 seconds ke qareeb pressure, ek ya chand repetitions ke sath istemal hota hai. Discomfort ko bardasht ke qabil rakhein aur treatment ke baad symptoms ke flare se bachein.

beats.patient: Elena, 37, tension headache with a tender knot at the top of the right shoulder.
beats.assessment: Pressing the upper trapezius reproduces pain behind her eye.
beats.treatment: You hold steady pressure for 60 seconds, twice, then guide a gentle neck stretch.
beats.reassess: Tenderness drops from 7/10 to 3/10 and neck rotation improves. You add posture and shoulder exercises.
beats.ur:
Ek misal se poora clinical flow dekhein:
Farz karein shoulder ke paas ek sensitive muscle area dabane se patient ka pehchana hua dard reproduce hota hai. Clinician gentle pressure ka response dekhta hai aur baad mein relevant movement dobara check karta hai. Yeh sirf illustrative example hai.

text.en:
The mistakes I see most often:
• Using fast, repeated jabs.
• Pressing far past tolerance.
• Not stretching afterward.
text.ur:
Sab se aam ghaltiyan:
• Using fast, repeated jabs.
• Pressing far past tolerance.
• Not stretching afterward.

text.en: Studies suggest short-term relief of pain for some patients, but the existence and exact nature of trigger points are debated. Treat results as pain relief, not proof of a specific structural cause.
text.ur: Compression ke baad movement, pain aur activity tolerance dobara check karein. Relief temporary ho sakta hai aur trigger-point theory ki interpretation par scientific debate maujood hai; certainty overstate na karein.

text.en: One line to carry into the clinic: **Find the spot, hold steady, stretch, retest.**
text.ur: Yeh tasur na dein ke painful point ko 'destroy' karna ya aggressively release karna zaroori hai.
